Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL941 to define the compound set (parent and all salts). Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno, then docs on doc_id, then activities on record_id, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter for target CHEMBL1936 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Do not limit rows.
